name: Zyss Serpentfolk
source: Homebrew example, worked out from the serpentfolk in Pathfinder Monster Core (pg. 302-305: Zyss Serpentfolk, Coil Spy, Bone Prophet), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Monsters.aspx?ID=3181. Not a Paizo adjustment.
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For an NPC. Replaces its ancestry trait with serpentfolk (or adds it); Medium; adds Aklo, Sakvroth, telepathy 100 feet, darkvision, scent, Speed 25 feet if lower, poison resistance, a fangs Strike with serpentfolk venom, Thin of Blood, +4 status vs. mental and +1 status vs. magic; occult innate spells and envenomed piercing weapons (options). Use Zyss or Aapoph, not both.
optional: Some serpentfolk have other innate spells, usually illusions, mental spells or divinations (Monster Core's Serpentfolk Magic), by their minimum rank: 6th mislead, zealous conviction; 5th mind probe; 4th honeyed words; 3rd dream message, enthrall, mind reading; 2nd invisibility (self only); 1st mindlink, phantom pain.

changes.saveNote: +4 status vs. mental; +1 status to all saves vs. magic

choices.label: Serpentfolk venom DC
choices.note: Most zyss use the standard DC for their level.

items.label: Occult innate spells: suggestion, illusory disguise, blur, ventriloquism
Envenomed weapons: its piercing Strikes add serpentfolk venom

choices.label: Maintain Disguise (for an infiltrator, as the Coil Spy)

abilities.name: Thin of Blood
abilities.description: {Name} recovers slowly from injuries. When {name} takes physical damage from a critical hit, they gain {=1 + max(0, level) / 8}d4 persistent bleed damage. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to flat checks to recover from persistent damage and saving throws against afflictions.

abilities.name: Maintain Disguise
abilities.description: {Name} can maintain an ongoing illusory disguise as long as they are conscious without having to recast the spell; they need only Cast the Spell again to reassume their illusory disguise if they wish to change their appearance or if the active spell is dispelled. {Name} typically seeks privacy when they need to sleep, as an ongoing illusory disguise ends an hour after they fall unconscious.

abilities.name: Serpentfolk Venom
abilities.description: Saving Throw DC {dc:standard} Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round); Stage 2 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

abilities.name: Serpentfolk Venom
abilities.description: Saving Throw DC {dc:hard} Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round); Stage 2 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)
